name: King Kong
description: King Kong, the patron saint of Nantianmen, works with Qingtian to maintain order at the entrance to heaven. It has the meaning of protecting the home, ensuring safety, helping utilitarianism, and bringing good luck, and can bring good luck to people. Its shape is novel and unique, the armor and machinery are exquisitely integrated, and the black yellow and silver white collide, making it dazzling. He stands solemnly, looking forward, holding a thorn in his hand, looking brave and mighty, like a general descending from the sky, very suitable for guarding the home.
